assumptions.laner: level 1 to 3 laner: hit_damage 65, attack_speed 0.65, attack_range 550, aoe_dps 70 (ChampionInput defaults), always a valid minion target
assumptions.champion_stand: a champion stands one melee range short of the enemy lead minion while the waves are in contact, and 550 short of it (outside minion acquisition range) once its own wave is gone; never inside enemy tower range plus 50
assumptions.champion_hold: a holding champion stays one melee range short of the enemy lead minion with or without its own wave, and backs up no further than the point that keeps that minion 300 outside its own tower's range
assumptions.wave_span: a wave is every minion within 1500 units of its team's lead minion, or of the front for the thin trigger
assumptions.crash: a crash is a run of ticks with the blue lead minion inside the red tower's attack range, gaps under 5 s merged
assumptions.line: front scalar: the contact point; out of contact, the lead minion of the team that has marched further from its spawn
assumptions.centre: the lane centre is the midpoint of the two spawn points, where undisturbed waves meet
assumptions.perturbation: S1b removes the last red caster of wave 1 before the waves meet
assumptions.built_state: S4b and S5b start at 180 s with full-health waves in contact 300 units outside the blue outer tower's range in top lane, surplus red casters on the red caster line, next waves on the normal clock
assumptions.slow_push_thin: S4b thin: blue thins until three red casters have died, then last-hits
assumptions.freeze_thin: S5b thin over n: the holding champion thins while red minions within 1500 of the front outnumber blue ones by more than n, and last-hits otherwise
assumptions.fight: S0 starts at 181 s at the top lane centre so that no reinforcement arrives within the 55 s window
